title: Union of the Duchy of Brittany with the Crown of France
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Union of the Duchy of Brittany with the Crown of France", at revision 1354555975, opens: "The union of the Duchy of Brittany with the Crown of France was the culmination of a political process begun at the end of the 15th century in the wake of the Mad War. It resulted in the Edict of Union of 13 August 1532 and the incorporation of the duchy into the Crown lands of France, a critical step in the formation of modern-day France." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3550076, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "historical event". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
